title: Inventor Manufacturing Documentation Governance

scope.purpose: Govern minimum documentation conventions and release readiness for Inventor manufacturing deliverables.
scope.boundary: The source page establishes the governed subject and high-level requirements but references a more detailed historical style-guide source for dimensions, symbols, title blocks, and other drafting conventions. Those detailed rules are not invented here.

requirements.statement: Governed Inventor manufacturing deliverables shall use approved templates and title blocks applicable to the project and manufacturing context.

Manufacturing drawings and related documentation shall comply with the approved dimensional, annotation, symbol, detailing, and presentation rules applicable to the governing manufacturing documentation standard.
Manufacturing documentation shall be reviewed against the governing documentation requirements before release to manufacturing or external parties.
Released documentation shall retain sufficient metadata and identity for governed Vault and CDE registration and downstream traceability.

open_gaps: Detailed dimensioning, tolerancing, symbol, title-block, layer, and presentation rules require a separate extraction from the referenced detailed source before this standard can be considered complete.
industry_alignment_candidates: ISO 129-1 for presentation of dimensions and tolerances
ISO 16792 for digital product definition practices
ISO 5457 for drawing sheet size and layout
ASME Y14.5 where the project or manufacturing context uses ASME GD&T conventions

provenance.source_title: S9 – Inventor Standards / Style Guide (Manufacturing Documentation)
provenance.migration_note: Migrated the high-level manufacturing-documentation obligations. Detailed drafting rules remain a source-extraction gap and external industry standards are recorded only as alignment candidates pending curator review.
